Unit: FILES
Eligibility definition: certificate matching supplier, lot, item, asset repair, revision, and signature
Exclusion definition: expired, unsigned, wrong-lot, or similar-item certificates
Control: immutable certificate identity and applicability to the repair material

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000087, organization SEA, and CASE-087. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from repair release window; external timing is conditional on supplier certificate confirmation. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

Decision scope: certificate of conformance.

Establish the immutable source record and effective revision, then reconcile candidate certificates, certificate matching supplier, lot, item, asset repair, revision, and signature, and expired, unsigned, wrong-lot, or similar-item certificates from independent records. Do not treat a header total, filename, similar name, or unapproved alternative as evidence. The final mutation must be atomic and limited to the supported record and measure.

Required closeout records: prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it; and record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell.

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000087, organization SEA, and CASE-087. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

Internal timing comes from repair release window; external timing is conditional on supplier certificate confirmation. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
